name: List All Custom Fields
description: Returns all custom fields that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filters for custom fields. All GET requests must include a filter for [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the custom field

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The name of the custom field

responseFields.name: data[].EntityType
responseFields.description: The type of entity for which the custom field was created. Entity types include properties, units, associations, and others.

responseFields.name: data[].EntitySubType
responseFields.description: The sub-type of the entity for which the custom field was created. For example, a property entity's sub-type could be "Single Family." If EntitySubType is null, the field applies to all possible entity sub-types.

responseFields.name: data[].Instruction
responseFields.description: Any additional instructions or clarification relating to the custom field

responseFields.name: data[].DefaultValue
responseFields.description: The default value set for the custom attribute. If DefaultValue is null, no default value was set for this custom field.

responseFields.name: data[].Required
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the custom attribute was marked as required by the AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the custom field's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Options
responseFields.description: The option(s) set for the custom attribute. If Type is set to Select or Select Multiple, several values can be present.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
